title: Page 5
content_zh:
“你也下去歇息吧，待我跟你家小姐用完膳，自会差人通知你。”兰泗一如往常的斯文有礼。
丽儿嘻嘻笑着告退。她这是第一次如此近看兰泗贝勒，难怪总是听说许多格格和官宦人家的女儿们都对他十分倾心，儒雅清俊的外貌以及透着贵气的书卷味，她从没见过这等天人般的翩翩美男子呢。
“初荷想吃些什么，我命小总管尽量张罗。”他亲自重沏了一壶茶，替她斟满。
“驿站附近地处偏僻，就别费心了。”她向来不注重吃喝，倒是对于兰泗第一次喊她的名字暗自羞赧。
“是吗？我以为女孩子家总会有特别爱吃的小点心。”至少有个人就是如此。
初荷瞧他神色微显落寞，知道他想起了谁，连忙岔开话题。
“贝勒爷方才在写些什么？我可以看看吗？”她站起身看向桌上宣纸。
“你喊我什么？”兰泗笑起来，觉得颇有趣。“怎么如此拘谨。”
初荷原本已经平抚了心情，这下子耳根又燥热起来。“那不是您的封号吗？”
“怎么要嫁人了还这么傻气？若是不嫌弃，你也跟敦华一样喊我大哥吧。”他又笑了。
“那……我知道了……”很少看见兰泗笑得如此开怀，他真该多笑，那真是最好看的模样。
只是她并不想跟敦华一样喊他大哥。
“我这只是随意写写，打发时间罢了。”兰泗见她好奇望着纸张，于是解释着。
蝶影纷纷，百花竟争妍。
初荷盯着纸上那俊逸笔迹，尤其是最后一个妍字，她知道正是那人的芳名，可见得兰泗并非随意写写，他只是舍不得离开京城。
“好一个百花竟争妍。”她喃喃低语，满是羡慕那个被兰泗爱着的女孩儿。
“来，你也饿了，吃些食物好好养足精神。”他开门示意小总管伺候两人用膳。
看着仆役们摆上好几碟精致小菜和香气四溢的热汤，初荷等到厢房内又只剩下他两人时，忍不住大着胆子央求。
“你……可以写些字送我，就当作是送别之礼吗？”连她自己都没想到就这么脱口而出心底的愿望。
兰泗愣了一下，随即微微笑着。“这有何难。不过，可得等我们饭后才能动笔。”

初荷漾开笑意。想来也是好笑，自己多年来倾心于他，这却是第一次两人能够单独面对面好好交谈。
“初荷今日看来有些不同于以往。”兰泗向来心思细腻，早发现了她平日并无上妆习惯，似乎也不注重服饰打扮。
“这不过是徒具形式罢了。”她低语。
兰泗微怔。他每每在官宦子弟聚会场所看到的女孩儿，都是絮絮叨叨说着梳妆打扮涂脂抹粉的事儿，可从没见到哪个竟然用“徒具形式”这般冷调的说法。
“我总算知道为什么你会和敦华交好了。”可不是吗？敦华向来自视甚高，压根儿不将寻常人看在眼里，却十分看重福大人庶出的小女儿。
初荷微微笑着。“不知这是褒是贬？”
“总是格外不同。”他不刻意说些褒扬的话，但着实认为眼前女子跟敦华一样气质独特。“来，我们以茶代酒，算是互相道别。”
他亲自替初荷斟满茶杯。
“一路顺风。”兰泗看向他。
初荷直勾勾看进他那对黑白分明的澄澈眸子，忽然涌出前所未有的感伤与不舍，禁不住眼波闪烁，却在接收到兰泗疑惑的询问眼神时迅速低下头。
“初荷先干为敬。”她一古脑儿的饮完一杯热茶，然后取出手帕擦拭嘴唇。
兰泗暗叹一口气，对于初荷即将面对的婚姻颇感同情，但心知肚明此事已毫无转圜余地，因此岔开话题。“等会儿你想让我写些什么？”
“就写此情此景吧，能够选在同一日出城，还在驿站碰面，这可真是不容易的巧合。”
“的确是很不容易的巧合。”兰泗学她说词，说着就站起身来移往书桌，自己磨墨铺好宣纸。
初荷瞧着，为他儒雅且专注的磨墨动作而心折。
兰泗提起笔，略为停住想了一下，便下笔流畅书写。
城郊小驿站　雨中两两相送行
此去千里　后会有期
末尾落款题上兰泗赠于初荷。
她站在一旁低低念着字句，再看着字迹流转之处虽然一笔一划十分好看，却无半分刚才那张“百花竟争妍”所透露的浓烈情感，不禁又有些失望。

“等干了再收起来。”兰泗看向她，却忽然愣了一下。
初荷不解，朝他视线低头一看，赫然发现兰泗盯着她颈上挂的那块玉佩，这下子瞬间耳根燥热，有如小孩童偷东西被当场逮到。
“这玉佩……”她太过大意了，平日都是塞进衣服里面，方才在轿子里百般无聊，才会取出抚着玩儿，哪想得到竟会被原物主看见呢！
“色泽和雕工都挺精巧雅致，是你父母亲特地准备的嫁妆吧。”他那一眼瞥见时怎觉得好眼熟？
“不是。”看来事隔多年，他应该早遗忘了。“这可说是一位故人给的吧。”
既然认为此玉佩精巧雅致，怎么当年压根儿没想回头捡？初荷暗暗在心底反问。
“你出嫁之日还配戴着，显见是一个很重要的朋友。”兰泗礼貌性的随口问，并无探其隐私之意。
初荷随意应了一声，只希望他别再说关于玉佩的事。她极少感到如此困窘与心虚呢。
“贝勒爷，雨已停了，不知咱们何时要启程？”小总管在门外恭问。
“是啊，也该离开了，此刻赶去下一个驿站刚好傍晚。”兰泗盘算着。“你们的队伍往西边走也是一样，现在启程，可在入夜前抵达一间客栈。”
“是啊，也该走了。”初荷点点头。
“临康，你去唤初荷小姐贴身婢女前来。”兰泗走去开门吩咐。
“咱们也该离开了。”
“是。”小总管不敢怠慢半分。
终须一别。初荷听见丽儿的脚步声，就立即告辞，转身前将兰泗的模样看进心底，毅然迈步离开。
兰泗拾起搁在茶几上的书卷再度翻阅，一边等着小总管前来，一边翻书喝茶，却忽然眉眼扯动，讶然愣住。
那玉佩的温润色泽与雅致雕工……他想起来了，玉佩主人不就是……
——可说是一位故人给的。
再想起方才初荷的小女儿羞态与急欲掩饰的惶然心虚，难道她……
兰泗一刹间心思百转，手上书卷啪的一声掉落在地。

果真是一去千里。兰泗风尘仆仆抵达边疆营区已是数十日之后，放眼所见尽是辽阔大漠与牛羊成群；策马奔驰，强烈如刀割一般的冷风直直打上他的脸庞。
此情此景迥异于他在京城所习惯的一切。
不仅如此，他虽然贵为贝勒，且身为圣上钦差，却也和一般士兵同样住在帐棚内，每日陪着将领操兵演练，倦也便跟着大家席地而睡，更别说是饮食起居，当然再无京城里的精致讲究，日日粗茶淡饭，甚且跟着打猎烤肉，豪迈而食。
初期真是苦不堪言。兰泗这才明白无论他以前在京城里如何不仰赖王府，或是他如何的想摒弃尊贵奢华的生活享受，但终究来说他仍是养尊处优的贵族子弟，来到边疆才真正切身体验到寻常人的生活。
但他并不以为苦，这番折腾反倒让他再无多余心思去遥想北京城那段痴心苦恋。
反而是小总管每每哭丧着脸追在他身边恳求：“贝勒爷，您好歹回自己的帐棚内歇息一下，这睡在粗石子上面可是会生病的。”
content_en:
"You should go down and have a rest. When your lady and I have finished our meal, I will send someone to notify you." Lan Si was as polite as ever.
Li'er giggled and excused herself. This is the first time she has seen Lan Sibeile so close. No wonder she has always heard that many princesses and daughters of officials and officials are very attracted to him. With his elegant and handsome appearance and his noble and scholarly smell, she has never seen such a handsome and beautiful man like a heavenly being.
"What would Chu He want to eat? I'll order the young manager to find out as much as possible." He brewed a pot of tea himself and filled it for her.
"The inn is in a remote area, so don't bother." She never paid much attention to food and drink, but she was secretly embarrassed when Lan Si called her name for the first time.
"Really? I thought girls always have their favorite snacks at home." At least that's the case for one person.
Chu He saw that he looked slightly lonely and knew who he was thinking of, so he quickly changed the topic.
"What was Mr. Belle writing just now? Can I see it?" She stood up and looked at the rice paper on the table.
"What did you call me?" Lan Si laughed, finding it quite interesting. "Why are you so reserved?"
Chu He had already calmed down his mood, but now his ears became hot again. "Isn't that your banned account?"
"Why are you so stupid after getting married? If you don't mind, you can call me big brother like Dun Hua." He smiled again.
"Then...I know..." It's rare to see Lan Si smile so heartily. He really should smile more, that's really the most beautiful look.
It's just that she doesn't want to call him big brother like Dun Hua.
"I'm just writing randomly to pass the time." Lan Si explained when he saw her looking at the paper curiously.
The shadows of butterflies are numerous, and the flowers are vying for beauty.
Chuhe stared at the elegant handwriting on the paper, especially the last word "yan". She knew it was the name of that person, which showed that De Lansi did not write casually, he was just reluctant to leave the capital.
"What a beauty." She murmured, full of envy for the girl who was loved by Lan Si.
"Come on, you're hungry too, eat some food and refresh yourself." He opened the door and motioned to the butler to serve the two of them.
Watching the servants put out several plates of exquisite side dishes and fragrant hot soup, Chuhe waited until he was the only two people left in the wing, and couldn't help but boldly begged.
"You...can you write some words for me as a farewell gift?" Even she herself didn't expect to blurt out her deepest wish like this.
Lan Si was stunned for a moment, then smiled slightly. "What's so difficult about it? But we have to wait until we have dinner before we can start writing."
Chu Heyang smiled. It's funny to think about it. I have been falling in love with him for many years, but this is the first time that the two of them can have a good conversation alone face to face.
"Chuhe looks a little different today than before." Lan Si has always been delicate and has noticed that she has no habit of wearing makeup and doesn't seem to pay attention to clothing.
"It's just a formality," she whispered.
Lan Si was slightly startled. Every time he saw girls at gatherings of officials and officials, they would always talk about dressing up and applying makeup, but he had never seen any of them use such a cold expression as "just a formality."
"I finally know why you became friends with Dunhua." Isn't that right? Dun Hua has always had a high self-esteem and does not look at ordinary people at all, but he attaches great importance to Master Fu's little daughter who is a concubine.
Chuhe smiled slightly. "I wonder if this is a compliment or a criticism?"
"It's always extraordinarily different." He didn't mean to say complimentary words, but he really thought that the woman in front of him had the same unique temperament as Dun Hua. "Come, let's have tea instead of wine and say goodbye to each other."
He filled Chuhe's tea cup himself.
"Have a nice trip." Lan Si looked at him.
Chu He looked straight into his clear black and white eyes, suddenly filled with unprecedented sadness and reluctance. She couldn't help but her eyes flickered, but she quickly lowered her head when she received Lan Si's questioning look.
"First of all, please do it first as a courtesy." She said with an ancient thought.After drinking a cup of hot tea, he took out his handkerchief and wiped his lips.
Lan Si sighed secretly, feeling quite sympathetic to Chu He's upcoming marriage, but knowing that there was no room for change in the matter, she changed the subject. "What do you want me to write about later?"
"Let's just write about this situation. It's not an easy coincidence to be able to choose to leave the city on the same day and meet at the inn."
"It is indeed a very rare coincidence." Lan Si imitated her words, stood up and moved to the desk, where he polished the ink and laid out the rice paper.
Chu He looked at it and was heartbroken by his elegant and focused ink-burning movements.
Lan Si picked up the pen, paused and thought for a moment, then started writing smoothly.
A small post station on the outskirts of the city, seeing each other off in the rain
We have traveled thousands of miles and will see you again later
The inscription at the end states that Lan Si presented it to Chuhe.
She stood aside and recited the words in a low voice, and then looked at the handwriting. Although the strokes were very beautiful, they did not have half of the strong emotions revealed in the "Hundred Flowers Strive for Beauty" just now, and she couldn't help but feel a little disappointed.
"Put it away when it's dry." Lan Si looked at her, but was suddenly stunned.
Chu He was puzzled and looked down at his gaze. She suddenly found Lan Si staring at the jade pendant hanging around her neck. Her ears suddenly felt hot, like a child caught stealing something.
"This jade pendant..." She was too careless. She usually stuffed it into her clothes. Just now when she was bored in the sedan chair, she took it out and played with it. How could she have imagined that the original owner would see it!
"The color and carving are very exquisite and elegant. It must be a dowry specially prepared by your parents." Why did he feel so familiar when he saw it?
"No." It seems that after so many years, he should have forgotten it. "It can be said that this was given by an old friend."
Since you thought this jade pendant was exquisite and elegant, why didn't you think about picking it up back then? Chuhe asked secretly in his heart.
"You still wore it on your wedding day. It's obvious that you are a very important friend." Lan Si asked politely and casually, without any intention of exploring his privacy.
Chu He responded casually, hoping he would stop talking about the jade pendant. She had rarely felt so embarrassed and guilty.
"Master Beile, the rain has stopped. When will we set off?" the young steward asked respectfully outside the door.
"Yes, it's time to leave. It's just evening to rush to the next station." Lan Si thought about it. "The same goes for your team heading west. Set off now. You can reach an inn before nightfall."
"Yeah, it's time to go." Chu He nodded.
"Linkang, go and call Miss Chuhe's personal maid." Lan Si went to open the door and gave instructions.
"It's time for us to leave."
"Yes." The young manager didn't dare to neglect even a little bit.
There must be a final farewell. When Chu He heard Li'er's footsteps, he immediately left. Before turning around, he looked at Lan Si's appearance deeply in his heart and walked away resolutely.
Lan Si picked up the book on the coffee table and read it again. While waiting for the little manager to come, she flipped through the book and drank tea, but suddenly her eyebrows twitched and she was stunned.
The gentle color and elegant carving of the jade pendant... He remembered, isn't the owner of the jade pendant...
——It can be said that it was given by an old friend.
Thinking again of Chuhe's little daughter's shyness and eagerness to hide her guilty conscience, could it be that she...
Lan Si's mind was racing for a moment, and the book in her hand fell to the ground with a thud.
It’s really a journey of a thousand miles. It had been dozens of days since Lan Si arrived at the border camp in the dust. All he could see was the vast desert and herds of cattle and sheep. As he rode his horse, the cold wind as strong as a knife hit him straight in the face.
This situation and scene were completely different from everything he was used to in the capital.
Not only that, although he was a Baylor and an imperial envoy of the Holy Emperor, he lived in a tent like ordinary soldiers and accompanied the generals in military drills every day. When tired, he slept on the floor with everyone, let alone his food and daily life. Of course, he did not have the exquisiteness of the capital. He had simple meals every day, and even hunted and barbecued, and ate boldly.
earlyThe period was really miserable. Only then did Lan Si understand that no matter how much he did not rely on the palace in the capital, or how much he wanted to give up the noble and luxurious life enjoyment, in the end, he was still a pampered aristocratic child. Only when he came to the border did he truly experience the life of ordinary people.
But he didn't think it was bitter. This torment made him no longer think about the infatuated love in Beijing.
Instead, the young steward would always chase him with a sad face and plead: "Master Beile, you should go back to your tent and have a rest. You will get sick if you sleep on the rough stones."
